nodes.title: CURRENT SCENE — FL2VA PROMPT / SEED / TIMING

widgets_values:
This workflow intentionally has no reference scheduler and uses ComfyUI's core MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo node. With both image sockets connected it is FL2VA; disconnect Picture 2 for I2VA, disconnect Picture 1 for L2VA, or disconnect both for T2VA.

1. Select real opening and ending images. The bundled filenames are placeholders.
2. In Scene Prompt Editor, replace the generic motion path with what visibly connects those exact frames. Keep the first FL2VA alignment line and its 5.17-second endpoint because this plan uses exactly 124 raw frames.
3. Click @ Reference to inspect Picture 1 and Picture 2; hover either chip for its image preview. These are native keyframe labels, not scheduled aliases.
4. Queue, then use Review Gate to approve, edit+retry, reroll, or stop.
5. Final Assemble preserves generated audio and uses a date token. Existing files receive _001, _002, and so on.

The one-scene plan is deliberate: a globally connected first/last pair would otherwise be reapplied to every recursive scene. For a long T2VA continuation, disconnect both keyframes and add scenes. For a later isolated FL2VA scene, use a one-scene plan or render it as its own run.

How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 5.17-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, begin from the exact subject identity, wardrobe, environment, lighting, camera angle, framing, pose, object placement, and spatial relationships established by <Picture 1>. Build one continuous shot with no cut. The principal subject initiates the concrete action described for the selected keyframes while the camera follows with a smooth tracking move at a measured speed. Preserve anatomy, materials, scale, contact points, screen direction, and lighting continuity throughout the transition. Every intermediate movement must visibly connect the opening state to the ending state: limbs and handled objects travel through plausible arcs, clothing and hair respond with restrained secondary motion, background parallax matches the camera path, and no object appears, disappears, or teleports. During the final second, progressively reduce the remaining differences in pose, camera position, framing, object state, background alignment, and illumination, landing exactly on the subject placement, composition, and visual state established by <Picture 2> at the final frame. Replace this generic action path in the Scene Prompt Editor with the actual motion that connects your two selected images before rendering.

overall_soundscape: Continuous environmental room tone appropriate to the two keyframes, with synchronized footsteps, fabric movement, handled-object sounds, and spatial reflections matching the visible action. Avoid abrupt ambience changes at the beginning or end.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

Then write exactly these fields in order:

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Describe the continuous visible path from Picture 1 to Picture 2.

overall_soundscape: Describe ambience and synchronized physical sounds.

non_diegetic_music: Describe audience-only music, or N/A.

Both keyframes connected = FL2VA. Only first = I2VA. Only last = L2VA, where the lone last frame is called <Picture 1>. Neither = T2VA.

Use one scene when a global first/last pair must apply once. For a long T2VA continuation, disconnect both images before adding scenes. Plan uses generated_audio, so no source-song wiring is required.
